verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State is a jurisdiction-bound government filing agency, so letting users pick a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product. Its records are, by definition, state records. Filers choosing counties to receive copies of filings (docs-12) is record distribution, not a data-residency choice, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
